fixed_fields: 5 positive table factors: domicile exaltation sect-dependent triplicity term face

distributions: essential components by seven classical planets
partial numeric point sum with no strong threshold
Jupiter MC favorable-aspect promissor dignity distribution
house number/partial house score by planet
